verdict.rationale: Render shows built-in metrics for all of your Render infrastructure and can stream telemetry to external tools (render-docs-13), so cross-service dashboards are achievable only by exporting to a third-party observability tool. Nothing shows a native custom dashboard builder. Missing for 10: native custom dashboard creation, combining metrics across services in one view, any documentation of dashboard configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
